headline: Violent Counterattacks Shake Callahan's Passage as Fierce Contests Rake Weathered Expanse
war_summary: Since our previous dispatch, the central battle lines have convulsed under sharp counter-offensives. In Callahan's Passage, Colonial forces breached the Warden perimeter to claim one stronghold, sparking furious back-and-forth clashes that yielded two base exchanges and nearly 2,700 combined casualties over the past two hours alone. Weathered Expanse remains a swirling cauldron of violence, recording nine strategic base actions and over 1,300 casualties in the last two hours, shifting the territorial ledger to five Colonial bases, one Warden, and three standing ruined as no-man's-land. Mooring County similarly witnessed a sudden Colonial return, with two positions changing hands amidst six recent base events centered on Gravekeeper's Holdfast and MacConmara Barrows. Farther west along the Nevish Line, combat intensity accelerated past 1,400 casualties in two hours without further altering the six-to-two Warden distribution. Meanwhile, secondary skirmishes in Dead Lands, Linn of Mercy, and Marban Hollow remain subdued, and earlier island theaters such as Kuura Strand and Fishermans Row report complete operational quiet.
